mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO reader_chapter_event (client_event_id, reader_key_hash, book_id, index_id, event_type, progress_percent, duration_seconds) VALUES (#{clientEventId}, #{readerKeyHash}, #{bookId}, #{indexId}, #{eventType}, #{progressPercent}, #{durationSeconds})
mapper.select: WITH event_reader AS ( SELECT e.index_id, e.reader_key_hash, MAX(e.event_type = 'COMPLETE') AS completed, MAX(e.progress_percent) AS max_progress, MAX(e.duration_seconds) AS max_duration FROM reader_chapter_event e WHERE e.book_id = #{bookId} AND e.create_time >= #{startTime} AND e.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY e.index_id, e.reader_key_hash ), eligible_retention AS ( SELECT er.index_id, er.reader_key_hash, next_bi.id AS next_index_id FROM event_reader er JOIN book_index current_bi ON current_bi.id = er.index_id JOIN book_index next_bi ON next_bi.book_id = current_bi.book_id AND next_bi.index_num = current_bi.index_num + 1 ), retained AS ( SELECT DISTINCT eligible_retention.index_id, eligible_retention.reader_key_hash FROM eligible_retention JOIN event_reader next_reader ON next_reader.index_id = eligible_retention.next_index_id AND next_reader.reader_key_hash = eligible_retention.reader_key_hash ) SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.book_name AS bookName, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT reader_key_hash) FROM event_reader), 0) AS uniqueReaders, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_reader), 0) AS chapterStarts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(completed) FROM event_reader), 0) AS chapterCompletions, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(completed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM event_reader), 0) AS completionRate, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retained) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM eligible_retention), 0) AS nextChapterRetentionRate, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(max_duration) FROM event_reader), 0) AS readingSeconds, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_buy_record ubr WHERE ubr.book_id = #{bookId} AND ubr.create_time >= #{startTime} AND ubr.create_time < #{endTime}), 0) AS purchaseCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ubr.user_id) FROM user_buy_record ubr WHERE ubr.book_id = #{bookId} AND ubr.create_time >= #{startTime} AND ubr.create_time < #{endTime}), 0) AS buyerCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ubr.buy_amount) FROM user_buy_record ubr WHERE ubr.book_id = #{bookId} AND ubr.create_time >= #{startTime} AND ubr.create_time < #{endTime}), 0) AS grossRevenueXu, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(we.amount) FROM ledger_transaction lt JOIN wallet_entry we ON we.ledger_transaction_id = lt.id JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.id = we.wallet_account_id JOIN book_index bi ON CAST(lt.business_id AS UNSIGNED) = bi.id WHERE lt.business_type = 'CHAPTER_PURCHASE' AND bi.book_id = #{bookId} AND wa.owner_type = 'AUTHOR' AND wa.owner_id = #{authorId} AND wa.account_type = 'AUTHOR_REVENUE_XU' AND we.amount > 0 AND lt.create_time >= #{startTime} AND lt.create_time < #{endTime}), 0) AS authorRevenueXu FROM book b WHERE b.id = #{bookId}

WITH event_reader AS ( SELECT e.index_id, e.reader_key_hash, MAX(e.event_type = 'COMPLETE') AS completed, MAX(e.progress_percent) AS max_progress, MAX(e.duration_seconds) AS max_duration FROM reader_chapter_event e WHERE e.book_id = #{bookId} AND e.create_time >= #{startTime} AND e.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY e.index_id, e.reader_key_hash ), event_agg AS ( SELECT index_id, COUNT(*) AS readers, SUM(completed) AS completions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(completed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS completion_rate, ROUND(AVG(max_progress), 2) AS average_progress, ROUND(AVG(max_duration), 0) AS average_duration_seconds FROM event_reader GROUP BY index_id ), retention_agg AS ( SELECT current_reader.index_id, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(next_reader.reader_key_hash) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS next_retention_rate FROM event_reader current_reader JOIN book_index current_bi ON current_bi.id = current_reader.index_id JOIN book_index next_bi ON next_bi.book_id = current_bi.book_id AND next_bi.index_num = current_bi.index_num + 1 LEFT JOIN event_reader next_reader ON next_reader.index_id = next_bi.id AND next_reader.reader_key_hash = current_reader.reader_key_hash GROUP BY current_reader.index_id ), purchase_agg AS ( SELECT ubr.book_index_id AS index_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ubr.user_id) AS buyer_count, SUM(ubr.buy_amount) AS gross_revenue_xu FROM user_buy_record ubr WHERE ubr.book_id = #{bookId} AND ubr.create_time >= #{startTime} AND ubr.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY ubr.book_index_id ), revenue_agg AS ( SELECT CAST(lt.business_id AS UNSIGNED) AS index_id, SUM(we.amount) AS author_revenue_xu FROM ledger_transaction lt JOIN wallet_entry we ON we.ledger_transaction_id = lt.id JOIN wallet_account wa ON wa.id = we.wallet_account_id JOIN book_index revenue_bi ON CAST(lt.business_id AS UNSIGNED) = revenue_bi.id WHERE lt.business_type = 'CHAPTER_PURCHASE' AND revenue_bi.book_id = #{bookId} AND wa.owner_type = 'AUTHOR' AND wa.owner_id = #{authorId} AND wa.account_type = 'AUTHOR_REVENUE_XU' AND we.amount > 0 AND lt.create_time >= #{startTime} AND lt.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY CAST(lt.business_id AS UNSIGNED) ) SELECT bi.id AS indexId, bi.index_name AS indexName, bi.index_num AS indexNum, COALESCE(ea.readers, 0) AS readers, COALESCE(ea.completions, 0) AS completions, COALESCE(ea.completion_rate, 0) AS completionRate, COALESCE(ra.next_retention_rate, 0) AS nextChapterRetentionRate, COALESCE(ea.average_progress, 0) AS averageProgress, COALESCE(ea.average_duration_seconds, 0) AS averageDurationSeconds, COALESCE(pa.purchase_count, 0) AS purchaseCount, COALESCE(pa.buyer_count, 0) AS buyerCount, COALESCE(pa.gross_revenue_xu, 0) AS grossRevenueXu, COALESCE(reva.author_revenue_xu, 0) AS authorRevenueXu FROM book_index bi LEFT JOIN event_agg ea ON ea.index_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN retention_agg ra ON ra.index_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN purchase_agg pa ON pa.index_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN revenue_agg reva ON reva.index_id = bi.id WHERE bi.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY bi.index_num LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_index WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
